envelope.description: Publish through the canonical artifact queue with revision checks

body.title: Publish through the canonical artifact queue with revision checks
body.summary: Add completion-publisher.ts guarded persistence using the daemon-owned ArtifactStore/History/LifecycleService. Support explicit absent-head creation and expected-revision update under the existing canonical queue, with fresh ownership/pin checks inside the mutation boundary.
acceptanceChecks: Canonical mutation compares frozen expected absence/revision atomically under the existing artifact queue; no check-then-write race or direct JSON overwrite.
Same operation plus exact subject/checkpoint/content returns existing revision with no new write/logged round.
Different/newer/human-edited canonical head returns conflict and is not overwritten.
Recheck current-owner assertion, independent party and pinned source/BUILD/contracts immediately before canonical mutation.
Validate adapted record in memory and verify persisted head/revision after lifecycle write; two stores are treated as recoverable commits, not one atomic transaction.

tests.name: Canonical artifact queue creates or updates only the frozen expected revision
Owner freshness and canonical identity checks refuse concurrent or edited heads
